description: Renovate's settings for sohedra/sohedra, on top of the organization's. CONTRIBUTING.md § Pull requests sets the titles; scripts/renovate.ts checks the peer rule.

customManagers.description: zizmor, which CI runs with pipx, not as an action.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates of dev dependencies merge themselves once CI passes. Dependencies ship to users, so they never do.
zizmor joins the GitHub Actions pull request, with Bun, which Renovate reads from pnpm/setup's runtime input.
GitHub Actions updates merge themselves once CI passes, except a major.

The repository allows pnpm/setup at one commit only, so its update fails CI at startup until a person allows the new commit in Settings > Actions > General and in ALLOWED of scripts/workflows.ts, in place of the old one.
prBodyNotes: Before this can pass CI, allow the new commit of pnpm/setup in Settings > Actions > General and in `ALLOWED` of `scripts/workflows.ts`, in place of the old one.

packageRules.description: A peer's next major or next 0.x minor widens the peer range from its tested floor and moves the exact dev copy beside it, one pull request per upstream repository, so CI's newest job tests it. A person merges it.
Lynx moves one version at a time, with the engine-upgrade checklist, in one pull request.
The released Svelte the tests compare with (svelte-released) waits for a person.
Svelte's custom-renderer build is pinned to a pkg.svelte.dev URL on purpose. Renovate skips URL versions anyway; a person moves it, with the binding's contract tests.
engines.node follows the support policy, by hand.
The repository's own Node.js: CI runs the newest release in devEngines' range already, so only a new LTS major opens a pull request, for a person, who also updates CONTRIBUTING.md § Setup.
The repository's own pnpm, in devEngines and packageManager together, waits for a person.
